hindi: द्यूत-अध्यक्ष द्यूत को एकमुख करवाए।
english: The superintendent of gambling should have gambling done one-mouthed.
notes: eka-mukha kept literal 'one-mouthed' (glossary 4.2); possible sense 'under a single control/entrance' not applied. kārayet = should have (it) done.
lines_deva: द्यूत.अध्यक्षो द्यूतम् एक.मुखं कारयेत्
lines_iast: dyūta.adhyakṣo dyūtam eka.mukhaṃ kārayet

words.gloss: for the purpose of making known those living in secret

hindi: अन्यत्र जुआ खेलने वाले के लिए दण्ड बारह पण का, गुप्त रूप से जीविका चलाने वालों को ज्ञात कराने के लिए।
english: Elsewhere, for one who gambles, the penalty [is] of twelve paṇas, for the purpose of making known those who live in secret.
notes: anyatra: glossary (5.2) gives 'except' for the case with a governed noun; here none is stated, so the plain 'elsewhere' (i.e. gambling outside the one-mouthed place of unit 1) is used; settled in glossary 3.20. gūḍha-ājīvin = 'living in concealment', literal; who they are (thieves, criminals) is not stated and not supplied. Hindi जुआ खेलने वाले renders dīvyataḥ.
lines_deva: अन्यत्र दीव्यतो द्वादश.पणो दण्डो गूढ.आजीवि.ज्ञापन.अर्थम्
lines_iast: anyatra dīvyato dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍo gūḍha.ājīvi.jñāpana.artham

hindi: “द्यूत के अभियोग में जीतने वाले के लिए प्रथम साहस-दण्ड, हारे हुए के लिए मध्यम
english: “In a charge of gambling, for the winner the first fine for rashness, for the defeated the middle
notes: GROUPING: units 3 and 4 form one sentence, the quoted view of the teachers; the unit-3 English ends open and the quote closes in unit 4. 'madhyamaḥ' bare, nothing supplied (glossary 4.11). abhiyoga rendered 'charge'; alternative 'prosecution/suit'.
lines_deva: "द्यूत.अभियोगे जेतुः पूर्वः साहस.दण्डः, पराजितस्य मध्यमः
lines_iast: "dyūta.abhiyoge jetuḥ pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, parājitasya madhyamaḥ

hindi: क्योंकि यह मूर्ख जाति का है, जीतने की इच्छा वाला, हार सहन नहीं करता,” ऐसा आचार्य कहते हैं।
english: For this [one] [is] of a foolish kind, desirous of winning; he does not tolerate defeat,” say the teachers.
notes: Continues the quote opened in unit 3. Closing iti carried by the quotation mark; 'X iti ācāryāḥ' as in glossary 3.5. bāliśa 'foolish/childish'; jetu-kāma = jetum-kāma with m dropped.
lines_deva: बालिश.जातीयो ह्य् एष जेतु.कामः पराजयं न क्षमते" इत्य् आचार्याः
lines_iast: bāliśa.jātīyo hy eṣa jetu.kāmaḥ parājayaṃ na kṣamate" ity ācāryāḥ

hindi: “नहीं,” ऐसा कौटिल्य कहते हैं।
english: “No,” says Kautilya.

text_flags.why: 'ity' is the sandhi form of iti before a vowel, but the next word begins with k; possible typo (compare the same line in other chapters).

notes: Formula 'na iti kauṭilyaḥ' as in glossary 12.1. Two w entries for the '-' join.
lines_deva: न-इत्य् कौटिल्यः
lines_iast: na-ity kauṭilyaḥ

hindi: यदि हारे हुए को दोगुने दण्ड वाला किया जाए, तो कोई राजा के पास नहीं जाएगा।
english: If the defeated one were made [one] having a double penalty, no one will approach the king.
notes: Reading dvi-guṇa-daṇḍaḥ as a bahuvrīhi agreeing with parājitaḥ; alternative: 'if a double penalty were imposed (kriyeta) on the defeated', same sense. 'na kaścana' = no one.
lines_deva: पराजितश् चेद् द्वि.गुण.दण्डः क्रियेत न कश्चन राजानम् अभिसरिष्यति
lines_iast: parājitaś ced dvi.guṇa.daṇḍaḥ kriyeta na kaścana rājānam abhisariṣyati

hindi: क्योंकि जुआरी प्रायः झूठे खिलाड़ी हैं।
english: For gamblers [are] mostly false players.
notes: kūṭa-devin: devin = one who plays dice (√div); kūṭa = false/fraudulent, literal.
lines_deva: प्रायशो हि कितवाः कूट.देविनः
lines_iast: prāyaśo hi kitavāḥ kūṭa.devinaḥ

hindi: उनके शुद्ध अध्यक्ष काकणियों और पासों को स्थापित करें।
english: Their superintendents, pure, should place the kākaṇīs and the dice.
notes: kākaṇī kept untranslated (glossary 4.10). 'teṣām' = of those (gamblers or their places); plural 'adhyakṣāḥ' follows the text. śuddha 'pure', i.e. clear of fault, literal.
lines_deva: तेषाम् अध्यक्षाः शुद्धाः काकणीर् अक्षांश् च स्थापयेयुः
lines_iast: teṣām adhyakṣāḥ śuddhāḥ kākaṇīr akṣāṃś ca sthāpayeyuḥ

hindi: काकणियों और पासों के अन्य को रखने पर दण्ड बारह पण का; कूट-कर्म में प्रथम साहस-दण्ड, जीते हुए को वापस लेना; और उपधि में चोरी का दण्ड।
english: In the placing of another of the kākaṇīs and dice, the penalty [is] of twelve paṇas; in false action, the first fine for rashness, the taking back of the won; and in upadhi, the penalty for theft.
notes: Doubtful: anya-upadhāna is rendered literally 'placing of another' (commonly understood as substitution; not applied). upadhi kept untranslated (glossary 4.2). kūṭa-karman 'false action' literal.
lines_deva: काकण्य्.अक्षाणाम् अन्य.उपधाने द्वादश.पणो दण्डः, कूट.कर्मणि पूर्वः साहस.दण्डो जित.प्रत्यादानम्, उपधौ स्तेय.दण्डश् च
lines_iast: kākaṇy.akṣāṇām anya.upadhāne dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, kūṭa.karmaṇi pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍo jita.pratyādānam, upadhau steya.daṇḍaś ca

words.gloss: hire of kākaṇī, dice, arālā and śalākā
buying of water, ground and work

hindi: जीते हुए द्रव्य में से अध्यक्ष सैकड़े पाँच, काकणी, पासे, अराला, शलाका का किराया, तथा जल, भूमि, कर्म का क्रय ले।
english: From the won property the superintendent should take five per hundred, the hire of the kākaṇī, dice, arālā and śalākā, and the buying of water, ground and work.
notes: 'pañcakaṃ śatam' = five (parts) in the hundred, literal; 'five per cent' is the usual sense. arālā and śalākā kept untranslated (glossary 4.10 for arālā); the literal gloss of śalākā is 'rod'. avakraya = hire (glossary 4.1/5.2), alternative 'buying back' not used. kraya 'buying/price' of water, ground and work is obscure; kept literal.
lines_deva: जित.द्रव्याद् अध्यक्षः पञ्चकं शतम् आददीत, काकण्य्.अक्ष.अराला.शलाका.अवक्रयम् उदक.भूमि.कर्म.क्रयं च
lines_iast: jita.dravyād adhyakṣaḥ pañcakaṃ śatam ādadīta, kākaṇy.akṣa.arālā.śalākā.avakrayam udaka.bhūmi.karma.krayaṃ ca

hindi: द्रव्यों का बन्धक और विक्रय करे।
english: [One] should make the pledge and the sale of the property.
notes: Subject not stated; the superintendent of the preceding unit is understood. dravya here 'goods/property', as in unit 10. ādhāna = pledge (glossary 4.1).
lines_deva: द्रव्याणाम् आधानं विक्रयं च कुर्यात्
lines_iast: dravyāṇām ādhānaṃ vikrayaṃ ca kuryāt

words.gloss: of the faults of dice, ground and hand

hindi: और पासे, भूमि, हाथ के दोषों को न रोकने पर दण्ड दोगुना।
english: And in not preventing the faults of dice, ground and hand, the penalty [is] double.
notes: Two w entries for the '-' join ca-apratiṣedhane. pratiṣedhana = prevention/prohibition, literal.
lines_deva: अक्ष.भूमि.हस्त.दोषाणां च-अप्रतिषेधने द्वि.गुणो दण्डः
lines_iast: akṣa.bhūmi.hasta.doṣāṇāṃ ca-apratiṣedhane dvi.guṇo daṇḍaḥ

words.gloss: from the samāhvaya of knowledge and skill

hindi: इससे समाह्वय की व्याख्या की गई, विद्या और शिल्प के समाह्वय को छोड़कर।
english: By that, the samāhvaya is explained, except the samāhvaya of knowledge and skill.
notes: Formula 'tena X vyākhyātaḥ' as in glossary 4.1. samāhvaya kept untranslated (literal 'calling together/challenge'), as the sense (wager contest) is not stated. anyatra + ablative = except (glossary 5.2). The final iti closes the section on gambling and is not rendered (no 'thus'); glossed 'closing particle'.
lines_deva: तेन समाह्वयो व्याख्यातः, अन्यत्र विद्या.शिल्प.समाह्वयात् । इति
lines_iast: tena samāhvayo vyākhyātaḥ, anyatra vidyā.śilpa.samāhvayāt | iti

words.gloss: of [things] borrowed, hired, pledged and deposited
of the fixings of watch, shadow and sitting together
in passing beyond place and time

words.gram: pres. part. caus. m. gen. sg. √sādh

hindi: किन्तु प्रकीर्णक—माँगे हुए, किराये पर लिए हुए, बन्धक रखे हुए, जमा रखे हुए के देश और काल के अनुसार न देने पर, अथवा पहर, छाया, साथ बैठने की व्यवस्थाओं के देश और काल का अतिक्रमण करने पर, ब्राह्मण से गुल्मतर-देय सिद्ध कराने वाले के लिए, और प्रतिवेश और अनुवेश के ऊपर निमन्त्रण करने पर बारह पण का दण्ड।
english: But miscellaneous: in not giving, according to place and time, of [things] borrowed, hired, pledged and deposited; or in passing beyond place and time of the fixings of watch, shadow and sitting together; for one who makes a brāhmaṇa accomplish the gulmatara-deya; and in inviting above the prativeśa and anuveśa — the penalty [is] of twelve paṇas.
notes: Many obscure points, kept literal. (1) yācitaka etc.: neuter -ka forms read as 'things borrowed' etc. (avakrītaka = hired, 5.2; āhitaka = pledged; nikṣepaka = deposited, 4.6); the noun is supplied only in English brackets. (2) yāmac.chāyā is regular sandhi (yāma + chāyā); yāma = watch, chāyā = shadow; the compound with samupaveśa and saṃsthiti is doubtful (appointments/arrangements for meeting at a time marked by watch and shadow is a possible sense, not applied). (3) gulmatara-deya kept untranslated (gulma 'post', tara 'crossing' are possible members; Kangle-type sense 'dues at post and ferry' not applied). sādhayataḥ is a causative: 'makes accomplish'; alternative sense 'exacts/recovers from a brāhmaṇa'. (4) prativeśa and anuveśa kept untranslated (neighbouring houses/persons is the likely sense); 'upari' with genitive 'above', alternative 'passing over'. (5) tu rendered 'But'; the dash is the printed dash after 'prakīrṇakam'.
lines_deva: प्रकीर्णकं तु - याचितक.अवक्रीतक.आहितक.निक्षेपकाणां यथा.देश.कालम् अदाने, यामच्.छाया.समुपवेश.संस्थितीनां वा देश.काल.अतिपातने, गुल्मतर.देयं ब्राह्मणं साधयतः, प्रतिवेश.अनुवेशयोर् उपरि निमन्त्रणे च द्वादश.पणो दण्डः
lines_iast: prakīrṇakaṃ tu - yācitaka.avakrītaka.āhitaka.nikṣepakāṇāṃ yathā.deśa.kālam adāne, yāmac.chāyā.samupaveśa.saṃsthitīnāṃ vā deśa.kāla.atipātane, gulmatara.deyaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sādhayataḥ, prativeśa.anuveśayor upari nimantraṇe ca dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ

words.gram: pres. part. m. gen. sg. pra-√yam
pres. part. caus. m. gen. sg. √laṅgh

words.gloss: to be spoken of by another

words.gram: pres. part. mid. m. gen. sg. √krī
pres. part. m. gen. sg. ud-√bhid
pres. part. m. gen. sg. ā-√car

hindi: निर्दिष्ट वस्तु न देने वाले के लिए, भाई की पत्नी को हाथ से लाँघने वाले के लिए, दूसरे के द्वारा रोकी हुई रूपाजीवा के पास जाने वाले के लिए, दूसरे के द्वारा कहे जाने योग्य पण्य खरीदने वाले के लिए, मुहर लगे घर को तोड़ने वाले के लिए, और सामन्त-चालीस-कुल्य की बाधा का आचरण करने वाले के लिए अड़तालीस पण का दण्ड।
english: For one not giving the thing directed; for one who oversteps a brother's wife with the hand; for one going to a courtesan held by another; for one buying wares that are to be spoken of by another; for one breaking open a sealed house; and for one practising the neighbour-forty-kulya harassment — the penalty [is] of forty-eight paṇas.
notes: Doubtful items, kept literal: sandiṣṭa artha 'thing directed' (alternatives: commissioned/agreed matter); laṅghayataḥ 'oversteps' with hastena (likely a physical offence; not applied); anya-uparuddhā 'held by another' (rūpa-ājīvā = courtesan, glossary 10.1); para-vaktavya 'to be spoken of by another' (likely 'claimed by another', not applied); samudra read as 'having a seal' (sa-mudra), homograph of 'sea' rejected by the context 'gṛham udbhindataḥ'; sāmanta-catvāriṃśat-kulya-ābādhā: sāmanta 'neighbour' (Book 3), kulya left untranslated (kinsman or measure), the relation of the members is unclear, ābādhā 'harassment'. A bare ca closes the series.
lines_deva: सन्दिष्टम् अर्थम् अप्रयच्छतो, भ्रातृ.भार्यां हस्तेन लङ्घयतो, रूप.आजीवाम् अन्य.उपरुद्धां गच्छतः, पर.वक्तव्यं पण्यं क्रीणानस्य, समुद्रं गृहम् उद्भिन्दतः, सामन्त.चत्वारिंशत्.कुल्य.आबाधाम् आचरतश् च-अष्ट.चत्वारिंशत्.पणो दण्डः
lines_iast: sandiṣṭam artham aprayacchato, bhrātṛ.bhāryāṃ hastena laṅghayato, rūpa.ājīvām anya.uparuddhāṃ gacchataḥ, para.vaktavyaṃ paṇyaṃ krīṇānasya, samudraṃ gṛham udbhindataḥ, sāmanta.catvāriṃśat.kulya.ābādhām ācarataś ca-aṣṭa.catvāriṃśat.paṇo daṇḍaḥ

words.gloss: of the holder of the family capital

words.gram: pres. part. m. gen. sg. adhi-√car
pres. part. m. gen. sg. abhi-√dhāv

words.gloss: in the tasks for gods and ancestors

words.gram: pres. part. caus. m. gen. sg. √bhuj

hindi: कुल-नीवी को ग्रहण करने वाले के अपव्यय में, स्वेच्छा से रहने वाली विधवा के पास बलपूर्वक जाने वाले के लिए, आर्य स्त्री को स्पर्श करने वाले चाण्डाल के लिए, विपत्ति में निकट वाले की ओर न दौड़ने वाले के लिए, बिना कारण दौड़ लगाने वाले के लिए, शाक्य, आजीवक आदि वृषल प्रव्रजितों को देव और पितृ कार्यों में भोजन कराने वाले के लिए सौ का दण्ड।
english: In squandering, of the holder of the family capital; for one approaching by force a widow living at will; for a caṇḍāla touching an ārya woman; for one not running toward one near in adversity; for one doing a running toward without cause; for one feeding vṛṣala renunciants, beginning with Shakya and Ajivaka, in the tasks for gods and ancestors — the penalty [is] of a hundred.
notes: Doubtful, kept literal: kula-nīvī-grāhaka 'holder of the family capital' (nīvī = capital, principal) with loc. apavyayane 'in squandering', unlike the genitive participles that follow; adhicarataḥ 'approaching' (glossary 4.9); caṇḍāla and ārya woman kept (glossary 4.7, 4.9); abhidhāv 'run toward', the sense 'run to help' not applied; vṛṣala left untranslated (literally outcaste/low-born) and 'pravrajita' = renunciant; kārya in deva-pitṛ-kārya 'tasks' (likely rites), a different word from 'matters' in unit 22. Bare number: 'of a hundred', unit not added (glossary 4.10).  No conjunction in the Sanskrit; none is added.
lines_deva: कुल.नीवी.ग्राहकस्य-अपव्ययने, विधवां छन्द.वासिनीं प्रसह्य-अधिचरतः, चण्डालस्य-आर्यां स्पृशतः, प्रत्यासन्नम् आपद्य् अनभिधावतो, निष्कारणम् अभिधावनं कुर्वतः, शाक्य.आजीवक.आदीन् वृषल.प्रव्रजितान् देव.पितृ.कार्येषु भोजयतः शत्यो दण्डः
lines_iast: kula.nīvī.grāhakasya-apavyayane, vidhavāṃ chanda.vāsinīṃ prasahya-adhicarataḥ, caṇḍālasya-āryāṃ spṛśataḥ, pratyāsannam āpady anabhidhāvato, niṣkāraṇam abhidhāvanaṃ kurvataḥ, śākya.ājīvaka.ādīn vṛṣala.pravrajitān deva.pitṛ.kāryeṣu bhojayataḥ śatyo daṇḍaḥ

words.gram: pres. part. caus. m. gen. sg. √pat

hindi: शपथ-वाक्य की अनुमति रहित पूछताछ करने वाले के लिए, और नियुक्त का कर्म, अनियुक्त के लिए, छोटे पशुओं और साँड़ों के पुंसत्व को क्षति पहुँचाने वाले के लिए, और दासी के गर्भ को औषधि से गिराने वाले के लिए प्रथम साहस-दण्ड।
english: For one doing an unpermitted oath-statement questioning; and for an unappointed one [doing] the work of the appointed; for one injuring the manhood of small animals and bulls; and for one causing the embryo of a female slave to fall with medicine — the first fine for rashness.
notes: Doubtful, kept literal: anuyoga = questioning (glossary 4.7/4.8; 5.4 'instruction' not used); aniṣṛṣṭa 'unpermitted'; 'ca-ayuktasya' is a '-' join, two entries; the participle is lacking for 'yukta-karma ca ayuktasya', so '[doing]' is bracketed (reading: an unappointed man performing the work of an appointed official); kṣudra-paśu-vṛṣa read as a dvandva 'small animals and bulls', alternative 'males of small animals'; puṃstva 'manhood'. The English 'with medicine' is the literal auṣadhena. Hindi: no subject or verb added.
lines_deva: शपथ.वाक्य.अनुयोगम् अनिषृष्टं कुर्वतः, युक्त.कर्म च-अयुक्तस्य, क्षुद्र.पशु.वृषाणां पुंस्त्व.उपघातिनः, दास्या गर्भम् औषधेन पातयतश् च पूर्वः साहस.दण्डः
lines_iast: śapatha.vākya.anuyogam aniṣṛṣṭaṃ kurvataḥ, yukta.karma ca-ayuktasya, kṣudra.paśu.vṛṣāṇāṃ puṃstva.upaghātinaḥ, dāsyā garbham auṣadhena pātayataś ca pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ

words.gloss: of maternal uncle and sister's son
one gone forth with a caravan
in the middle of a village

words.gram: pres. part. caus. m. gen. sg.

hindi: पिता और पुत्र, दम्पती, भाई और बहन, मामा और भानजे अथवा शिष्य और आचार्य के, परस्पर अपतित को त्यागने वाले के लिए; सार्थ के साथ निकले हुए को अथवा गाँव के बीच त्यागने वाले के लिए प्रथम साहस-दण्ड, बीहड़ वन में मध्यम, उसके निमित्त भ्रेष कराने वाले के लिए सर्वोच्च; साथ प्रस्थान करने वाले अन्यों में आधे दण्ड।
english: Of father and son, husband and wife, brother and sister, maternal uncle and sister's son, or pupil and teacher, for one abandoning one another [who is] not fallen; for one abandoning [him who has] gone forth with a caravan, or [abandoning him] in the middle of a village, the first fine for rashness; in a wilderness, the middle; for one causing bhreṣa for the purpose of that, the highest; among others setting out together, half penalties.
notes: Doubtful: the first clause is read as the dvandva pairs governing 'one of them abandoning the other who has not fallen' (parasparam 'one another'); the Sanskrit leaves the subject open. sārtha-abhiprayāta literal 'gone forth with a caravan' (alternative 'gone toward a caravan'). bhreṣa kept untranslated (glossary 4.1); 'tan-nimittam' = for the purpose of that (glossary 13.2). Bare madhyama/uttama = the middle / the highest, nothing supplied (glossary 4.11). kāntāra = wilderness (glossary 4.12). 'saha-prasthāyiṣu anyeṣu' read 'among others setting out together'. In w, 'tat-nimittam' is the unsandhied form of the compound printed 'tan.nimittaṃ'.
lines_deva: पिता.पुत्रयोर् दम्पत्योर् भ्रातृ.भगिन्योर् मातुल.भगिनेययोः शिष्य.आचार्ययोर् वा परस्परम् अपतितं त्यजतः, सार्थ.आभिप्रयातं ग्राम.मध्ये वा त्यजतः पूर्वः साहस.दण्डः, कान्तारे मध्यमः, तन्.निमित्तं भ्रेषयत उत्तमः, सह.प्रस्थायिष्व् अन्येष्व् अर्ध.दण्डाः
lines_iast: pitā.putrayor dampatyor bhrātṛ.bhaginyor mātula.bhagineyayoḥ śiṣya.ācāryayor vā parasparam apatitaṃ tyajataḥ, sārtha.ābhiprayātaṃ grāma.madhye vā tyajataḥ pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, kāntāre madhyamaḥ, tan.nimittaṃ bhreṣayata uttamaḥ, saha.prasthāyiṣv anyeṣv ardha.daṇḍāḥ

hindi: न बाँधने योग्य पुरुष को बाँधने वाले, बँधवाने वाले के लिए, अथवा बन्ध को छुड़वाने वाले के लिए, व्यवहार को प्राप्त न हुए बालक को बाँधने वाले या बँधवाने वाले के लिए एक हज़ार का दण्ड।
english: For one binding, causing to bind a man not to be bound, or causing release of a bond; for one binding or causing to bind a child who has not reached dealings — the penalty [is] a thousand.
notes: bandham mokṣayataḥ is obscure: bandha is kept literal 'bond' (possibly a bound person); 'a bond' is not an interpretation. aprāpta-vyavahāra = who has not reached dealings (glossary 3.5). The unit of the thousand is not stated and none is added. Subject of the verbs not stated.
lines_deva: पुरुषम् अबन्धनीयं बध्नतो बन्धयतो बन्धं वा मोक्षयतो, बालम् अप्राप्त.व्यवहारं बध्नतो बन्धयतो वा सहस्रं दण्डः
lines_iast: puruṣam abandhanīyaṃ badhnato bandhayato bandhaṃ vā mokṣayato, bālam aprāpta.vyavahāraṃ badhnato bandhayato vā sahasraṃ daṇḍaḥ

english: By the difference of man and offence a difference of penalty is to be made.
notes: viśeṣa 'difference/distinction', literal. puruṣa 'man/person'.
lines_deva: पुरुष.अपराध.विशेषेण दण्ड.विशेषः कार्यः

words.gloss: wearied by hunger, thirst and the road

hindi: तीर्थ-कर, तपस्वी, रोगी, भूख, प्यास, मार्ग से थका हुआ, पार के जनपद का, दण्ड से पीड़ित और अकिंचन अनुग्रह के योग्य हैं।
english: The tīrtha-kara, the ascetic, the sick, one wearied by hunger, thirst and the road, one of a country beyond, one afflicted by penalty, and the destitute are to be shown favour.
notes: Doubtful: tīrtha-kara kept untranslated (literally 'maker of a tīrtha'; the sense is not stated). tiro-jana-pada read as a bahuvrīhi 'whose country is beyond' (jana-pada = country, glossary 13.2); a foreigner is the likely sense but is not applied. daṇḍa-khedin 'afflicted by penalty' (daṇḍa as penalty, Book 3); the alternative 'weary of the staff' is possible. 'ca-anugrāhyāḥ' is a '-' join, two entries; the plural anugrāhyāḥ is not labelled accusative.
lines_deva: तीर्थ.करस् तपस्वी व्याधितः क्षुत्.पिपासा.अध्व.क्लान्तस् तिरो.जन.पदो दण्ड.खेदी निष्किञ्चनश् च-अनुग्राह्याः

words.gloss: by the pretext of place, time and use

hindi: देव, ब्राह्मण, तपस्वी, स्त्री, बालक, वृद्ध, रोगी, अनाथों, पास न आने वालों के कार्य धर्मस्थ करें, और देश, काल, उपभोग के बहाने से लाँघें नहीं।
english: The dharmasthas should do the matters of gods, brāhmaṇas, ascetics, women, children, the aged and the sick, of the helpless, of those not approaching; and they should not pass over [them] by the pretext of place, time and use.
notes: kārya here 'matters' (likely cases/suits). atihareyuḥ literal 'carry beyond / pass over', object [them] supplied in English only; the sense (dismiss, put off) is not applied. anāthānām and anabhisaratām may qualify the preceding list instead of adding two groups. bhogac.chalena is regular sandhi (bhoga + chala); bhoga = use (glossary 3.8). dharmastha kept as a title (glossary 4.9).
lines_deva: देव.ब्राह्मण.तपस्वि.स्त्री.बाल.वृद्ध.व्याधितानाम् अनाथानाम् अनभिसरतां धर्मस्थाः कार्याणि कुर्युः, न च देश.काल.भोगच्.छलेन-अतिहरेयुः
lines_iast: deva.brāhmaṇa.tapasvi.strī.bāla.vṛddha.vyādhitānām anāthānām anabhisaratāṃ dharmasthāḥ kāryāṇi kuryuḥ, na ca deśa.kāla.bhogac.chalena-atihareyuḥ

words.gloss: by reason of excess of knowledge, intellect, manliness, high birth and action

hindi: और विद्या, बुद्धि, पौरुष, कुल, कर्म की अधिकता के कारण पुरुष पूजनीय हैं।
english: And men are to be honoured by reason of excess of knowledge, intellect, manliness, high birth and action.
notes: atiśaya here 'excess' (glossary 15.1; not 'special advantage'). abhijana = high birth (glossary 5.6); karma = action (glossary).
lines_deva: पूज्या विद्या.बुद्धि.पौरुष.अभिजन.कर्म.अतिशयतश् च पुरुषाः

hindi: इस प्रकार धर्मस्थ छल रहित दृष्टि वाले, सब भावों में सम, विश्वास के योग्य, लोक के प्रिय, कार्य करें।
english: In this way the dharmasthas should do the matters, seeing without pretext, equal in all states, trustworthy, dear to the people.
notes: evam rendered 'in this way' (a plain adverb, not the closing iti). bhāva 'state/condition', alternatives 'matters/cases'. loka 'people' (literal 'world'). kāryāṇi 'matters' as in unit 22.
lines_deva: एवं कार्याणि धर्मस्थाः कुर्युर् अच्छल.दर्शिनः
